goal: Route winter visitors by intent from the main site into one clear planning path, while preserving distinct search ownership for evergreen planning and live conditions.

requirements: tools hub routes skier, ice checker, winter-day planner and undecided visitor by task
main-domain XC planning hub owns the primary XC entry from Tools and structured data
live xcski remains an explicit secondary live-conditions destination
homepage exposes both XC planning and Michigan Ice without displacing the general tools CTA
XC and Ice continue to cross-link without creating a competing winter landing URL
persona CTA interactions remain measurable through the existing privacy-safe tool engagement tracker

fatalPenalties: a new indexable winter landing URL competes with /michigan-cross-country-skiing/ or /michigan-ice/
the Tools primary XC entry bypasses the main-domain planning hub
the live XC subdomain is removed from the flow
the Michigan Ice safety boundary is weakened
existing title, H1 or canonical ownership is changed just to make the routing layer work
